notes.title: Cat Quest III Turns 1 and More Exciting News!
notes.content:
[p]Cat Quest III turns 1 TODAY 🎉 😻 [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t believe it’s already been a year since Cat Quest III launched. Thank you to all our players sailing the Purribean with us and for all your surpawt, we couldn't have done it without you 💕[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/101c077be9e9f9cbd44b45fe056c4e560e7e90ad.png"][/img][/p][p]Since launch, we've continued to add more content, including mew quests, characters (looking at you Macho Dog), crewmates and treasure galore![/p][p]
If you’ve been busy pouncing around the Purribean and haven’t caught up with the news, you can find more information below.
[/p][p][b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/4441207839043616818"]Mew Content[/url][/u][/b][/p][p]☠️ Five New Side Quests[/p][p]🏴‍☠️ Four New Dungeons[/p][p]🐾 Three New Boss Fights[/p][p]💎 New Gear Galore[/p][p][/p][p][b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/500564506841187169"]Mew Game Mode[/url][/u][/b][/p][p]Mew Game Mode allows the player to add a variety of unique meowdifiers to their game for a more challenging experience, including ‘Ruffer Enemies’, where different and more powerful enemies appear; ‘Fast Furwards’, where everything moves at twice the speed - even you; ‘No Levelling’ and many more![/p][p]
[b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/537730617501024362"]Tavern Tales Update[/url][/u][/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2305840/view/537730617501024362"]
[/url]⚔️ 5 Tavern Tale boss fights, including a secret one that only unlocks after completing all the tales.[/p][p]🦜 5 unlockable Crew Mates[/p][p]🏴‍☠️ More Wanted posters for completing new bosses that were added in previous updates.[/p][p]🎁 A new trinket is given by Mama Milka for defeating the Dragon Boar.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Cat Quest III Arrives on Apple Devices![/b][/h2][p]
Cat Quest III is now available on the [u][url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cat-quest-iii/id1551304183"]App Store[/url][/u] for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, featuring all the content updates that have been released. Play with touchscreen controls with your iPaws or team up in co-op by connecting two supported controllers and explore the Purribean together![/p][p][/p][p]The game is free to try, and you can unlock the full game via an in-game purchase.[/p][p]
Available meow on the App Store with up to [b]50% off[/b] for a limited time.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Pawsome Steam Sales[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]To celebrate all of this, our catventure Cat Quest III is [b]50%[/b] off until [b]August 21st[/b]![/p][p]
If you're new to our catventures, why not check out our previous titles: [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/593280/Cat_Quest/"]Cat Quest[/url][/u], [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/914710/Cat_Quest_II/"]Cat Quest II[/url][/u] and an array of meowverlous bundles are up to [b]80% off[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: All A-pawd! Cat Quest III has landed ashore!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JoIGmxVr0P8;full][/previewyoutube]

Set sail in this 2.5D open-world action RPG and brace yourself for a meow-nificent journey filled with furry fun and adventure. Play alone, or locally with a friend, and defeat those troublesome Pi-Rats. 

Dive into a paw-geous new world with varied dungeons, biomes, and furr-ociously fun gameplay! Engage in fierce battles with a refined combat system featuring tighter attack combos and weapon swapping, and more customisation than ever before! Purrrrrfection.

[h2]Dress Fur Battle![/h2]

Discover trinkets from around the world to transform your character into a fur-midable Pi-rat beating Powerhouse! Experiment with dozens of gear sets, weapons, spells, and trinkets to purr-fect your ultimate build. You can even kit your ship out with some claw-some weapons!

For the fur-st time in the series, command your very own ship! Explore the seas, seamlessly zip to shore, and traverse the land on paw to hunt for booty. Discover treasures, furr-ocious spells, and gla-meow-rous costumes!

Uncover the secrets of the North Star. Cat Quest III is Out Now on Steam, and we are so excited fur you to get your paws on it. 

Paws Truly, 

The Gentlebros

notes.title: Cat Quest 2 gets free Challenge Mode and more to celebrate International Cat Day
notes.content:
Cat Quest 2, developer The Gentlebros' delightful feline-themed RPG sequel (also includes dogs), has just received a free new update, adding a Challenge Mode, new enemies, and more.

Released to celebrate International Cat Day - and the original Cat Quest's third birthday, fact fans - Cat Quest 2's Mew World update introduces a host of nifty new features and quality of life improvements, designed to finesse and expand the already engaging co-operative japery (and feline punnery) of the wonderfully accessible core game.

The headline Challenge Mode takes the form of eight game modifiers, unlocked once the main quest has been completed. These introduce special twists on the core experience which can be applied to a new play through - such as prohibiting levelling and upgrades, adding tougher enemies, and limiting the number of lives available - and can be stacked and combined to increase the challenge and any resulting rewards.

Read more

notes.title: The Mew World Update is now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Catventurers!

Today is finally the day, the day where we celebrate International Cat Day! 
A few notable things – it’s the 3rd anniversary of Cat Quest coming out on Steam! Thank you all for your support thus far! 

Which brings us to the second piece of news: the Cat Quest franchise has already sold 1.3 million units since it first came out, isn’t that clawsome?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/ae09d386a55c1ac884308b0259cd998b920f8f04.jpg[/img]
	

Finally, onto our piece de resistance, the Mew World Update is live for Cat Quest II! 
It’s free for everyone who already owns the game, and there is a limited-time discount to celebrate this occasion!
This update has created by The Gentlebros as a [i]‘huge thank you to all our fans who’ve supported us since day 1. We never thought our games would be played by so many people! We read every single review, and every message sent to us, and these improvements and tweaks are what we feel would make the game a lot more enjoyable for everyone![/i]’.


[b]The Mew Game[/b] 
There are now 8 meowdifiers you can equip once you’ve finished the story and choose a Mew Game. From no equipment to twice the speed or no magic at all, you can really challenge yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/565232a0477261aaa1004a0b6c66e635bc2db7fe.gif[/img]

Here's an example of the Naked Paws one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/11866b05c48b68e0187a433a88c48b6ac36d86d6.gif[/img]

Special tip: after you finish the Mew Game, a special set of armor will be unlocked for you! 


[b]Reworked inventory[/b]
A request of the fans, the sorting has been reworked and there is now a color code for rarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/131f97c74066b48591dc750a8eefe0fa1681fea3.png[/img]


[b]Sprinting[/b]
As shown before, after running for a few seconds, your cat and dog will speed up and travel faster across the kingdoms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/06cc90aa92feda7993a0f13fddb293483f443c30.gif[/img]


[b]Elemental damage[/b]
You can now better see which weapons do what sort of elemental damage, and the numbers change color depending on which element you’re using!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/01657ac99252c719f54582f6b84ed46ee2bfccc6.png[/img]


[b]New enemies [/b]
You can now really challenge yourself while crossing the oceans and get a new source of XP and gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/093466cf5b79b0873e557e562595a45c956cf6bb.png[/img]


[b]New Royal Arts[/b]
As demonstrated, you now have a special attack, Pawer Smash remastered, that triggers whenever you roll and attack! Each weapon type has a different devastating attack! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/8c06e2ad76fccc64663b896849b4b769b86fa997.gif[/img]


[b]Difficulty [/b]
Based on the feedback received, there is now a difficulty choice as well as tweak to balance out the weapon upgrades versus the enemies getting tougher as you get to higher levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/86b3ccde72b64c4f2f0ce8a2f610aaa965a2aef8.png[/img]


[b]Defense[/b]
The defense stat has been revamped and now works closer to how it did in Cat Quest! A shield is now over your life bar, and it will take damage first. It also recharges slowly over time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/91be5ecf88ec3fe1c5019e9a42dd98bab88c1c79.jpg[/img]


[b]Quality of Life[/b]
A lot of tweaks will make the game smoother overall, but you’ll also be able to check the level of the quests and dungeons before you enter. The Kingsmaker also displays the general direction it will teleport you towards. You can now finally delete your save files! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/4375c8243df29abd0e93f5621b1b01071bacce1d.jpg[/img]


The game is now also discounted for the next 48 hours at 33% if you have Steam friends who don’t have the game yet!
We hope you enjoy this update and revamped catventure!
Thank you again for your suppawt! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/35c320672982a063898972da4bd8fc0fcac63eaa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Game + Beta test is now LIVE
notes.content:
Hey fellow catventueres and doge knights! We are almost done with New Game + and we're looking for volunteers to try out the mode before we make it live! We'd love all feedback to fix as many things as possible.

If you're interested in helping, here is how you can do it:

[b] Step 1: Backup all your save files.[/b]
1. Go to C:\Users\User\Documents\Cat Quest II
2. Copy all the files here and paste them somewhere you can find them again.(eg. Desktop)

[b] Step 2: Opt into the New Game+ Internal test.[/b]
1. In your Steam library, right click on Cat Quest II.
2. Click on Properties.
3. Go to the Beta tab.
4. Type in this password: newgameplusinternal
5. Choose the New Game Plus internal branch.

[b] Step 3: Start a New Game Plus game.[/b]
1. To unlock New Game Plus, you first have to complete the epilogue. You must do this even if you had completed it before.
2. Once the epilogue has been completed again, a new option called New Game + should appear in the main menu.

We hope to get as many people test this as possible! And we hope everyone has fun doing so! :D

notes.title: Steam's Remote Play Together Makes Cat Quest II Online Pawssible!
notes.content:
Dear Catventurers, 

What exciting news for us all! Thanks to the new feature 'Remote Play Together' that was just enabled by Steam, you can now play Cat Quest II co-op online! Isn't that a furrmidable update?


[b]Here are the steps for you to enjoy Remote Play:[/b]
1. Enter the Steam Beta. You do this by clicking on Steam>Settings.
2. Start Cat Quest II.
3. While in the game, open the Steam Overlay(Shift-Tab).
4. Find the friend you want to play with and click the tiny arrow next to their name.
5. Select 'Remote Play Together'!

Important notice: Cat Quest II [i]does not support two sets of keyboards and mouses[/i], so at least one of you will need to use a gamepad in order to play together.

Finally, please enjoy this beautiful hawtdog sword to brighten your day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/cb8372694057a0f2eadf4a80b2198523cee7a964.png[/img]

notes.title: Cat Quest II is launching on consoles!
notes.content:
Dear Catventurers,

We're delighted to announce that Cat Quest II is out today for Nintendo Switch, Xbox One and PlayStation 4 in Europe and North America! 

If some of your furry friends are not PC gamers, fear not! We've now got the game on moar platforms for everyone to enjoy this adorable catventure! 

Under threat from a continuing war between the cats of Felingard and the advancing dogs of the Lupus Empire, Cat Quest II tells the tail of two kings, brought together against their will, on a journey of paw-some discovery to reclaim their thrones.

Play as both a cat and dog as you explore their kingdoms solo or with a friend in [b]local co-op[/b]! Quest in a world filled with magic, curious monsters, and go on a catventure like never before!

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Optimisations, Tweaks and 21:9 Support!
notes.content:
Hello Catventurers and Doge Knights!
We're excited to tell you guys the first patch for Cat Quest II is now LIVE!

[h1]Patch notes: [/h1]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed various crash bugs due to quests.
- Fixed various crash bugs due to co-op mode.
- Fixed a bug where dungeons were not completing.
- Fixed a bug where the Dungeon Master achievement was not triggering.
- Implemented various safeguards should the Settings file get corrupted.
- Implemented a handle should anti-virus prevent save files from being read.
- Minor bug fixes.

[b]Balance and tweaks[/b]
- Boss stats were tweaked.
- Spell stats were tweaked.(Lightnyan is stronger, Celestail is weaker)
- Mage weapons tweaked.(Mage weapon damage has been slightly reduced)
- Tutorials tweaked.(Tutorials now show that Mage weapons reduce 50% health more clearly)
- You can now access the map room in Purrn Cave normally.(use this to get the chest you missed!)
- Added 21:9 screen resolution support.

[b]Optimisations[/b]
- Optimisation done to some UI elements. (This should further increase fps for lower range computers)
- Increased overall stability.

Let us know if there are any issues with this patch(especially crashes!)!
We have more updates and improvements planned!
Hope everyone continues to enjoy Cat Quest II~!

-The Gentlebros

notes.title: Get your claws into Cat Quest 2 on Steam right now
notes.content:
Back when I lived with John Walker and Graham, we had a cat called Dexter. For one glorious afternoon, Dex wore a little camera around his collar. We saw what he got up to, which involved secret cat meetings under cars, and watching hot air balloons drifting over Bath. Then he lost it and we were denied any further glimpses into his world. I can see why. Cat Quest 2 s release trailer is rammed with adventures as the kitties battle action-RPG-style to keep the encroaching dogs of the Lupus Empire from overwhelming them. Dexter was clearly trying to protect us from the truth about the world.

notes.title: Cat Quest II - Out Neow!
notes.content:
[u][b][h1]Dear Catventures, the time has come! [/h1][/b][/u]

 We're delighted to share that the most pawsome RPG around Cat Quest II releases today on Steam! In the sequel to the award-winning indie hit Cat Quest, you'll be playing as both a cat and dog as you explore their kingdoms solo or with a friend! Quest in a world filled with magic, curious monsters, and go on a catventure like never before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/78f3749b670ae6ad69eaeb62ee84b72d9235c897.jpg[/img]

[i]Join us today at 2pm GMT over on the Cat Quest II Steam Page for a special launch day Stream![/i]

There's also a very cool bundle for a limited time where you can buy Cat Quest and Cat Quest II together with 10% off if you haven't already got the first one! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/8250b8d1c5418bed29a33b11a44dd57298efe76b.png[/img]

Cat Quest II is a fast paced open world action RPG where you play as both a cat and a dog. Explore a massive world filled with monsters, dungeons and quests, as you strive to bring peace back to your kingdoms during a time of war. Find, share and upgrade loot as well as powerful spells to quest your way through this adorable tail!

[h1][b]So What's Mew?[/b][/h1]

[b]A New Kingdom to Explore[/b]
 
Vast deserts, towering rocks and auburn meadows: the Lupus Empire is just as beautiful, unique and full of quests as its neighboring feline land. Catventure through this chequered realm, join furces with new allies and help liberate it from its emperor-gone-mad: Wolfen!

[b]Mewltiplayer![/b]
 
Whoever said that Cats & Dogs were enemies? An unlikely pair of heroes join furces in Cat Quest II, where you and a friend can team up for some multiplayer action! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/f178aab76d1aaa06361a700de479de426725bd54.png[/img]

[b]New weapons, spells and more![/b]
 
What would an adventure be without some sweet loot? Cat Quest II offers even more diversity by adding new weapon types - like ranged wands - and spells as well as passive skills on armour pieces you find and upgrade during your quests!

notes.title: Cat Quest 2 prepares for September launch on PC with new gameplay footage
notes.content:
Cat Quest 2, developer The Gentlebros' much-expanded casual action-RPG sequel, is out soon, and, in preparation for its 24th September PC launch, there's a fresh batch of gameplay video.

The original Cat Quest - which arrived on PC, Switch, PS4, and mobile in 2017 - was an absolutely delightful surprise, successfully distilling all the usual genre tropes down into a breezy but thoroughly entertaining feline RPG - replete with exploration, questing, dungeon crawling, and engagingly twitchy real-time combat. I loved every minute of its ridiculously charming, pun-filled adventure.

Cat Quest 2 retains the same casual-friendly core, but mixes things up with a range of new features - not least of which is playable dogs. There's also an entirely new kingdom to explore in the form of the Lupus Empire, and it promises to introduce much more environmental diversity compared to the original's rather same-y green hues - with new biomes including vast deserts, mountainous regions, and auburn meadows.
